entities.name: Karelon Frie
entities.description: Sachem of Valiton Hold and War Leader and advisor of Tagard Tarngold's army, who assassinated Tagard and seized power before being killed by Tallibeth.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Leader who united the hill people; Karelon had him assassinated.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Suderbod ambassador who conspired with Karelon.

entities.name: Rael Gar
entities.description: Killed by Karelon at a council meeting.

entities.name: Bey Lisolo
entities.description: Leader of the Viashino who joined Tallibeth.

entities.name: Janin
entities.description: Leader of the Garan family who joined Tallibeth.

entities.name: Heasos
entities.description: Viashino who burst into Karelon's bedroom with Tallibeth.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: City where Karelon held out in the north and was killed.

entities.name: Betrayal of Tamingazin
entities.description: Event in which Tagard was assassinated.

events.summary: Karelon, seeing Tagard would not exterminate the Viashino, conspires with Ursal Daleel and has Tagard assassinated.
events.quote: she conspired with Suderbod Ambassador Ursal Daleel and had Tagard assassinated

events.summary: Karelon drugs and kills Rael Gar with her sword at a council meeting.
events.quote: then killed him with her sword

events.summary: Tallibeth escapes the coup and joins Bey Lisolo's Viashino and the Garan family.
events.quote: joining forces with Bey Lisolo’s Viashino and the Garan family led by Janin

events.summary: Karelon destroys the city's keep and holds out in northern Berimish.
events.quote: Karelon began her rule by destroying the city's keep

events.summary: Tallibeth, Janin and Heasos burst into Karelon's bedroom and Tallibeth stabs her dead.
events.quote: Karelon was stabbed through by Tallibeth’s sword

relations.quote: then killed him with her sword
